message.content: {"caption":"Line chart of SpreadsheetBench verification pass rate by iteration, comparing greedy patch-pool strategies with full-aggregation baselines.","description":"The horizontal axis is Iteration, marked 0 through 10; the vertical axis is SpreadsheetBench-Vrf (%) with labeled ticks at 35, 45, 55, and 65, so the displayed scale does not start at zero. Three solid, marker-coded lines show greedy aggregation: blue circles, Greedy +Success, fall overall from about 50% to 56%, with a low near 36% at iteration 3; orange squares, Greedy +Error, rise from about 50% to around 63–65%, dip near 61% at iteration 6, and finish near 62%; green triangles, Greedy +Combined, rise from about 50% to about 66% at iteration 2, then fluctuate mostly around 59–63%. Three dashed horizontal lines are the full Trace2Skill aggregation baselines: +Success is about 66%, +Error about 65%, and +Combined about 70%. Thus the full +Combined baseline is highest; the greedy Error and Combined curves approach or briefly reach the Success and Error baselines, while greedy Success remains below them. In the page context, each greedy iteration adds one validation-selected patch from its named pool, while each flat line represents full aggregation of all patches.
